operations.description: In a 250 mL quartz round-bottom flask, combine 25 mg of one selected catalyst with 100 mL of one 25 ppm dye solution. Position 15 cm from the water-cooled 450 W Hanovia quartz mercury lamp in a dark box. Alternatives are separate assays, not combined charges.

operations.description: For TNTs and PbS/TNTs, replace the quartz flask with a Ray-sorb flask to filter wavelengths <600 nm. The source gives 4% transmission at 500 nm. Retain the same assay method; this is a parallel optical-control branch, not a step after UV–vis measurement.

quality.review_scope: Independent root scientific audit of all six supplied main pages, eight figures, Table 1, surface-charge equations and the 47-entry bibliography passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete six-page main scope; matching local SI not located and cited full methods, including references 29 and 30, remain unreviewed.
No atom-coordinate model, measured interface geometry or source-supported exact three-dimensional particle shape. Molecular and structural presentation remains pending where models are absent.
Physical batch IDs, synthesis yield and most stock preparation/storage details are unreported.
Commercial comparator and photocatalytic condition series are distinct from the three prepared material routes. Graph points are not digitized.
Assay alternatives share a protocol, not a physical batch. UV–vis settings, centrifuge conditions and exact sampled curve values are unavailable.
Dye forms are preserved by their Table 1 names/drawings and literal masses; no guessed hydrate/counterion normalization.
